♦️Write it: Tilapia; read it: the ISIS of Khuzestan's wetlands! 📚 @darvishnameh ✍️ And if we stay indifferent, it can, like a nightmare, become the killer of native aquatic species in wetlands across the entire country. All of us who love Iran must, at times like this, show that we will never sacrifice Iran's national interest and ecological future for the sake of immediate profit or personal or organizational gain. I am glad that on this issue, both the Department of Environment and the Parliament's Environment Fraction have taken wise and decisive stances against the tilapia mafia. ✅️ I draw your attention to Rokna's interview with Dr. Asghar Abdoli, a faculty member at Shahid Beheshti University, who warns in no uncertain terms: the spread of the invasive tilapia in Khuzestan has threatened native fish and the livelihood of fishermen, and without oversight, it could also harm the wetlands of northern Iran and drinking water sources: https://www.rokna.net/fa/tiny/news-1259108 #No_to_Tilapia #Mohammad_Darvish

🔰 The mafia theorizes, natural resources confirms!/How do we restrain the managers' decisions, El Niño?!✍ Hanif Reza Golzar🔻While over the past six months we were busy trying to prevent the collection of habitat trees under the false name of broken and fallen dangerous trees from the Hyrcanian bed, a new term was added to the knowledge of economic forestry! "Dangerous standing trees"!🔹 253 kilometers of Hyrcanian forests on both sides of the rivers from east to west of Mazandaran province, following the coalition of #Wood_Mafia and #Water_Mafia, are to be clear-cut under the pretext of confronting the #El_Niño phenomenon, and the revenues from it are to be spent on settling the debt of the country's Natural Resources and Watershed Management Organization to the Mazandaran Wood and Paper Company.🔻Now you might ask, how much is this entire debt for which they have auctioned off the national wealth of the forest?! 67 billion tomans!Does the debt of natural resources even have to be settled by cutting forest trees?!Where should we cry out this sorrow?! For 67 billion tomans, the wood mafia, in coalition with the water mafia, theorizes about "dangerous standing trees," the organization responsible for the country's natural resources confirms this false term, the judicial authority of Mazandaran province emphasizes acceleration, the governor and the Crisis Management Organization also support it under the pretext of confronting El Niño, Mazandaran Center TV constantly holds specialized roundtables! in confirmation of this plan and by injecting false and alarming data tries to win the support of local communities.... In short and clear, the door and the board have come together well!🔻Mr. Natural Resources Organization! Mr. Crisis Management Organization! Mr. Governor! Parliament employees! Mazandaran Province TV! Mazandaran Regional Water Company! The province's General Directorate of Natural Resources! You yourselves are the real El Niño! People are not afraid of nature's El Niño! It is your destructive decisions that cast terror into hearts!Iran's Natural Resources and Environment Watch
